card.name: Words just before "meal" in dosing
card.fires_on: Words right before "meal" or "meals" in dosing directions, such as "each", "three", "main", "a" after timing phrases like "before", "at the start of" or "over".

modes.label: Each/a before meal
modes.description: A determiner after a timing phrase like "before" or "at the start of", leading into "meal".
modes.example: initiate repaglinide at 0.5 mg before<< each>> meal and do not exceed a total daily

modes.label: Main or three before meals
modes.description: Words describing how many or which meals, in fat-intake or dose-with-meal directions.
modes.example: distribute the daily intake of fat over<< three>> main meals.

modes.label: Meal-related word parts
modes.description: Part of the word "meals" or a meal descriptor like "high-fat" in food-effect statements.
modes.example: MAY BE ADMINISTERED WITHOUT REGARD TO<< ME>>ALS.

card.writes: It pushes toward "confirm"-type words and away from "suggest" words, with no clear link to meals.
card.plain: It lights up on the small word just before "meal" in directions about taking a drug with or before meals.
